name: Buffer
tagline: Social scheduling API for multiple networks.
shortDescription: Buffer offers an API for publishing to many social networks, scheduling posts, and managing connected channels.
agentSummary: Agents can schedule content through one interface, but media/network-specific requirements and approvals still matter.
bestFor: Cross-network social scheduling, content calendars, and simple social automation.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Brand voice, platform policy, media requirements, and accidental posting need human approval. Posting, moderation, DMs, paid campaigns, platform policy, brand voice, and account reputation should stay human-reviewed for public or customer-facing actions. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Browser automation can be brittle around UI changes, MFA, captchas, policy prompts, and hidden confirmation states.
pricingSummary: Public channel/team-based pricing with free plan.
authModel: Buffer account auth and API access.
browserSupport: Calendar UI is useful for review and approval.

capabilities.detail: Buffer documents API-supported posting across Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, TikTok, and more.
Official docs are listed for API behavior, authentication, limits, examples, and setup review.
Pricing is public by channels and users.
Approval and calendar review are browser-first.
